hygId.description: HYG id of the primary star; null for exoplanet-catalog primaries without a HYG match.

starId.description: Stable star identity; matches the star celestial body id and star-list starId.

spectralClass.description: Source spectral class; null when unknown, never a generation fallback.

solarSystemSummary.description: Solar system registry summary enriched with optional count fields when available.

displayName.description: Authoritative system label. When an approved settlement name is enabled, format is 'Settlement Name (Original Catalog Designation)'; otherwise preserve the existing label.

settlementName.description: Bare approved settlement name, or null when no reviewed assignment is enabled.

aliases.description: Searchable source/catalog and historical display aliases. Does not replace canonical id.

hygSystemId.description: HYG fixture system grouping; null for systems that exist only in the exoplanet catalog.

catalogName.description: Scientific catalog designation of the system (for example '24 Boo'); displayName is the game name.

declaredStarCount.description: Star count the exoplanet archive declares (sy_snum); starCount includes synthesized companions that fill the gap.

distanceApproximate.description: True when distanceParsec and positionPc are estimated (photometric or default distance).

catalogSnapshotDate.description: Exoplanet-catalog snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD) for 'Data as of' attribution; set only for exoplanet-catalog systems.

positionPc.description: HYG-fixture system-wide coordinate in parsecs; not spatial.positionKm and not converted into the system-local celestial snapshots. Null means the global coordinate is unavailable.

requestId.description: Echoed caller correlation id when one was supplied on the request.

total.description: Number of items matching the filters, before paging. 0 on failure.

limit.description: Effective page size after defaulting and clamping.

hasMore.description: True when offset + limit < total. Request the next page with offset + limit.
